# This service name is used by Serverless Framework to create and manage AWS resources. 
service: worko-chat-api

frameworkVersion: "4"


provider:
  name: aws # The cloud provider
  runtime: nodejs14.x # runtime environment for your Lambda functions. 
  region: ap-south-1 # AWS region where your Lambda function will be deployed

plugins:
  - serverless-plugin-typescript # This plugin allows you to use TypeScript with Serverless Framework. It compiles TypeScript files into JavaScript during deployment.
  - serverless-offline # This plugin allows you to run your Serverless application locally for development and testing. It simulates AWS API Gateway and Lambda on your local machine.

# "websocketHandler" is the name of the Lambda function which will be create on aws
# "src/chat" is the path of the handler file
# "chatHandler" is the name of the exported function in src/chat.ts file
functions:
  websocketHandler:
    handler: src/chat.chatHandler
    events: # events that will trigger websocketHandler Lambda function
      - websocket:
          route: $connect # Triggered when a WebSocket client connects.
      - websocket:
          route: $disconnect # Triggered when a WebSocket client disconnects.
      - websocket:
          route: getClients # Custom route for retrieving clients.
      - websocket:
          route: sendMessage # Custom route for sending messages.
      - websocket:
          route: getMessages # Custom route for retrieving messages.
      - websocket:
          route: deleteMessage #(@todo, like delete all messages or particular message):- Custom route for deleting a particular message
